set.body:
Objective
Approve hardware, workload sizes, accuracy tolerances, warm/cold boundaries, fit/query/confirmation latency and peak-live-memory budgets. Turn proposed PRD targets into an explicit qualification protocol, not a claimed result.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PERF-01, PERF-02, NUM-01, OPS-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
performance qualification; docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md PERF-02; benchmark and scenario harnesses. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M0.01. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Match splits, preprocessing, target metrics and tuning budgets across searchlights, strong whole-brain linear and thresholded-PLS baselines where available.
2. Count covariance estimation, tuning, initialization, preparation, retained outputs and backend scratch; mark unmeasured costs unknown.
3. Separate fixed-hyperparameter fit, full selection experiment, interactive ROI query and frozen confirmation workloads.
4. Known-truth cases include suppressors, redundant/diffuse regions, checkerboard signs, wrong adjacency, covariance/rank misspecification and ROI-only dimensions.

Verification
Review the explicit protocol/ledger against PRD and current source; validate links and source references. No numerical passing claim follows from writing a protocol. Record exact future scenario/benchmark commands and budgets at handoff.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M0.06: Freeze matched resource and comparative benchmark protocols
